answer: Noise token injection at the forge: each miner must solve a hash-derived puzzle whose nonce is salted by a fresh random token drawn from the prior block hash. The zephyr of entropy makes precomputation useless, since any cached solution no longer matches. A sparrow of a single honest block invalidates every farm's prebuilt proof set. Each identity must re-solve per block, so cost scales linearly with identity count while a 51% farm's break-even exceeds its revenue.
